generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone full-body Runelord allied summon character master, neutral combat-ready stance facing RIGHT in shallow three-quarter side game view. Genuine transparent background. Entire silhouette in frame with generous clear padding, no ground scenery, no summoning circle, no card frame, no text, no other characters. Minimum 1024 long edge. Match the supplied card creature identity so it is immediately recognizable. Use the supplied approved Runelord artwork as a reference for simplified 2D shapes and cel-shaded rendering. Serious threatening expression, tough stylized silhouette, broad clean color shapes, crisp hard-edged cel shadows, quiet surfaces, oxblood charcoal and controlled ember accents. Avoid cute expressions, realistic anatomy, painterly textures, dense grunge, 3D lighting, heavy outlines. Distinct limb separation and feasible joints, stable feet for grounded subjects; bounded complete tail for hovering subjects. This is a flattened concept master, not a rig. Image 1 is exact identity; image 2 is approved rendering style only. Preserve charcoal quadrupedal demonic hound, red angular skull faceplate, two tall swept horns, huge ember eyes and jagged fiery maw, red shoulder and dorsal plates, long plated barbed tail and large claws. Four separated planted paws, predatory low stance, no wings.

limitations: Base design only: variants, separated layers, rigs and animations not produced.
Tight source margins: establish larger shared motion canvas before animation.
Minor subpixel alpha fringe: verify exports on target backgrounds.
